subject: Overflow web production help
body:
Hi Phil,

I’m a Milwaukee-based developer. If MKE Web Designs ever needs extra production capacity, I can help with scoped tasks like static landing pages, HTML/CSS cleanup, mobile QA, content migration, and simple automation scripts.

I put the agency-overflow details here: https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/overflow.html

My public samples are here: https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/#work

If it helps, send one small overflow task and I’ll reply with timing and either a fixed quote or hourly estimate.

Tate Lyman
https://tatelyman.github.io/tate-web-services/
lymantate2@gmail.com
